_comment: Team config for the cmux-team skill. spawn_team.py resolves a config in this order: --config PATH, then ./.cmux/team.json, then this bundled example. Copy it to ./.cmux/team.json and fill in real model IDs to customize. Placeholders (<...>) and __TOKENS__ are substituted at spawn time: __FEATURE__ = the feature slug, __APP_PATH__ = app_path below, __STACK__ = stack below, __SENTINEL__ = completion_sentinel below. The FIRST role is the lead (left half of the window); the rest fill a balanced grid on the right.
stack: <describe your stack, e.g. FastAPI backend + Vue 3 frontend>

roles.name: lead
roles.kickoff: You are the LEAD of team __FEATURE__ (app: __APP_PATH__). Your workers are the sibling panes in this window: plan, build-be, build-fe, test. Find their surface refs: run cmux identify --json for your workspace, then cmux list-pane-surfaces --workspace <ws>. Drive each worker with cmux send + send-key enter, and wait on cmux notification events for '__SENTINEL__: '. Wait for the orchestrator to hand you a feature, then plan -> build -> test.

roles.name: plan
roles.kickoff: You are the plan worker on team __FEATURE__. Reply with one line: ready: plan  then wait for the lead to assign work.
